description: For people who work at a vendor listed on Lode, or their agents. Claims every Lode page for the vendor so they can correct facts and get change alerts (at most one email a week). Give a work email on the vendor's domain (Lode emails one link; when someone clicks it, the pages are claimed) or the vendor's domain hosting /.well-known/lode.json (the first call returns a one-time claim_token to add to the file and a private claim_secret to keep; call again with both and the pages are claimed straight away; format at https://trylode.io/vendors/). Optional corrections and competitors go in with the claim. Claiming never changes rankings.

claim_secret.description: With claim_token: the private secret Lode returned on the first call (never put it in the file)

claim_token.description: With domain: the one-time token Lode returned on the first call, once it is in lode.json as "claim_token"

competitors.description: Apps the vendor is most often compared with

field.description: One of: plan, regions, sync, price, best_for, not_ideal_for, other

source.description: A public page that shows it (published as a sourced fact); without one it shows as "Vendor-reported" with the date

domain.description: Instead of email: the vendor's domain hosting /.well-known/lode.json, e.g. "katanamrp.com"

email.description: A work email on the vendor's own domain, e.g. "sam@katanamrp.com"

vendor.description: Lode vendor id, e.g. "katana" (optional; the email or domain decides)

name: claim_vendor
title: Claim a vendor's pages
